authority: #K2-463 sec.2.2 authorised the chain-side landing of the _v2 relocation drawing. Before wiring it, the planner was run ON THE REAL BOARD (read-only): this is the result, and it invalidates my own prescription.

refused.why: no item of this net/layer intersects the declared box

measured.why: NO-YIELD-ITEMS: the drawing yielded nothing to rip (fail-closed, never a silent no-op)

finding: DECISIVE AND SELF-CORRECTING: on the stitched board (the maze input, i.e. BEFORE any routing) the declared band contains ZERO GND F.Cu items (and zero MCU_VDD items; I2C1_SDA has 14 because those are DRAWN pieces). The GND wall that seals the port->pad channel is therefore copper that THE MAZE ITSELF ADDS during the run - not pre-existing drawing copper. A "rip before solving" prescription cannot work: there is nothing to rip yet.
what_this_invalidates: the _v2 relocation_listed piece (R1464) is INVALID as an action plan: its items_to_yield were derived from a pass-1 (post-routing) census, so it names a yielder that does not exist at the time the drawing would act. The fail-closed planner (R1468) caught this by returning NO-YIELD-ITEMS on the real board instead of silently no-oping - which is exactly what the gate was built for.
corrected_remedy_direction: the band must be expressed as a ROUTING-SIDE RESERVATION, not as a pre-solve rip: either (a) reserve the band as a lane the engine must not claim with GND (i.e. GND keeps out of x=[46.75,50.35], y=[53.6,60.1] on F.Cu while the I2C2_SCL edge is served), or (b) make the settlement treat SELF-ADDED copper as rip-able - which the pass-2 loop already does (it unwinds to the pre-loop snapshot) yet GND still wins the band, because the cost/ordering terms do not know that this particular band is reserved for I2C2_SCL. Option (a) is the smaller, deterministic change and is a means change: NOT started here.
honest_status: no chain wiring was made (it would have been a no-op by construction); the _v2 action plan must be revised before anything is landed. Zero exam runs; nothing landed on the board.
